name: Ahli Bank SAOG
hq: Ahli Bank Head Office Building, Al Rumaila Street, Wattaya
description: Ahli Bank SAOG (ahlibank) is a full-service Omani commercial bank providing both conventional and Sharia-compliant banking solutions across retail, SME, and corporate segments. The bank supports national economic diversification and private-sector expansion through credit intermediation, customer deposit mobilization, trade financing, and digital banking platforms. Expanding rapidly across its balance sheet, ahlibank reached OMR 4.62B in total assets and OMR 3.86B in net loans, advances, and Islamic financing as of September 2026. Disciplined cost management and broad customer franchise growth underpin its consistent earnings trajectory.
highlights: 9M 2026 net profit rose 12.5% YoY to OMR 36.54M on 7.0% higher operating income of OMR 92.96M.
Net loans, advances, and financing expanded 17.2% YoY to OMR 3,857.5M, driving total assets up 16.3% to OMR 4,624.4M.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Operating Income of OMR 117.75M and Net Profit of OMR 46.32M (Total Assets: OMR 4.62B).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 2,346 registered shareholders • Omani 97.1% | GCC 2.8% | Foreign & Arab 0.1% (5 disclosed 5%+ holders).
